evals.prompt: /scribe-notes Explain Gradient Descent and Ridge Regression for beginners with every equation explained step by step and a visual intuition plot.
evals.expected_output: Routes to M1 without scripts, explains equations for the intended learner, and uses an inspected, attributed local visual when a suitable one is available; otherwise reports the visual gap honestly.
expectations: Routes through /scribe-notes to master M1 (deep-notes) with no pre-generation knowledge quiz and zero generated scripts
Introduces plain-language motivation and intuition before displayed equations
Every display math $$...$$ block is immediately followed by '> [!note]- 📐 Understand this formula'
Uses only visually inspected local images with checked rights and attribution, or reports why a suitable image was unavailable

evals.prompt: /scribe-ytnote Build structured study notes from this lecture video with timestamps, equations, and clearest whiteboard frames: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aircAruvnKk
evals.expected_output: Uses the unified /scribe-notes video workflow, reports explicit access_state honestly, segments timestamped transcript blocks, keeps only clear inspected stills locally under assets/scriptorium/<slug>/ when accessible, and places collapsible formula folds directly beneath displayed math.
expectations: Uses unified video workflow inside /scribe-notes without creating a parallel generator or helper script
Records explicit video access_state honestly
Attaches '> [!note]- 📐 Understand this formula' directly under displayed equations

evals.prompt: /scribe-notes Create a compact formula sheet for Classical Thermodynamics equations with variable units and applicability conditions.
evals.expected_output: Selective context loads only M3 quick-reference + formula-sheet variant + math_gates without loading unrelated M1-M7 specs, producing dense equation blocks with symbols, SI units, and applicability conditions.
expectations: Routes to master M3 with variant 'formula_sheet'
Selective context omits unrelated M1/M5/M6 master templates
Includes explicit units and applicability conditions for every listed equation

evals.prompt: /scribe-notes Create notes on this transformer PDF strictly from the supplied source without external lookup.
evals.expected_output: Routes to master M2 (study-notes) preserving strict source_policy='strict', keeps supplied terminology and sequence intact with inline local prerequisite bridges if needed, and labels any unsupported passage explicitly rather than fetching external material.
expectations: Preserves source_policy='strict' without overriding source constraints during routing
Routes to M2 (study-notes) preserving source order and terminology
Marks missing/inaccessible details transparently rather than inventing external facts

evals.prompt: /scribe-doubt Based only on my existing Transformers vault notes, why do we scale dot-product attention by sqrt(d_k)?
evals.expected_output: Executes read-only lookup across existing vault notes, answers directly from retrieved content with exact [[Note Title#Heading]] wikilink citations, performs zero file edits, and skips note-creation templates.
expectations: Routes to /scribe-doubt Command A strictly read-only
Cites exact [[Note Title]] / [[Note Title#Heading]] wikilinks from existing vault notes
Performs zero file writes or external web searches

evals.prompt: /scribe-quiz Quiz me on my Logistic Regression vault notes one question at a time.
evals.expected_output: Launches interactive active-recall session under M6/Command G, asks one question and waits for learner response before grading against the vault note, and leaves vault files unchanged unless the learner asks to save weak spots.
expectations: Presents exactly one question per turn and waits for user reply
Grades strictly against existing vault note claims
Keeps YAML frontmatter clean without adding extra custom quiz keys

evals.expected_output: Persists configured vault_path and notes_folder in ~/.scriptorium-config.json directly and reports the resolved notes_path.
expectations: Updates ~/.scriptorium-config.json directly without creating a helper script
Reports saved vault_path, notes_folder, and notes_path from ~/.scriptorium-config.json
